subject: pricing on 12x9x4
body: Can you drop our price on the 12x9x4 boxes to $16 a bundle going forward?
We're buying a lot more of them now.

truth.handling: Price changes are never the agent's call, so it's routed to sales and the reply promises nothing.

forbidden.why: A price change is sales' decision.
